title: reconciliation
description: Created once per (run_id, period) by the bridge after the period's period_end is in the gap-free prefix: the period was re-read deduplicated, re-detected, missing moments and jobs were created (create-only) and differences from stored moments are listed. Frozen evidence is never overwritten. Recaps can say a period is reconciled.

through_sequence.description: Sequence of this period's period_end event.

expected_moments.description: Moments the shared detector finds for this period on the gap-free prefix.

stored_before.description: Moments of this period already stored when this cycle began.

created.description: Moments (each with its pending job) created in the reconciling cycle.

kind.description: evidence_differs: a stored moment differs from re-detection (kept as stored). unexpected_stored: stored but not re-detected.

status.description: reconciled when no mismatches; mismatch otherwise (an operator should look).
